body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>
Nokia has introduced its new model N92, the first integrated DVB-H mobile device in Nokia N series range for watching broadcast TV programs at CES 2006.

You can set reminders to watch your favorite TV programs or personal channel lists. IT features an ergonomic design, large 2.8-inch anti-glare QVGA screen with 16 million colors, the dedicated media keys, FM radio with visual radio support, and 2 megapixel cameras.
This model supports the new Nokia web browser with mini-map, that helps you to have zoom-out view of a web page as well as useful connectivity options such as Wi-Fi, infrared, bluetooth.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
